scenicChapters.title: Romania Maramures Wooden Churches Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 27 km this is Romania Maramures Wooden Churches Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-church-of-the-holy-archangels-kuz.story: From Rogoz it runs 185 km to Rogoz; allow about 3 h 11 of riding. On the way it passes Church of the Holy Archangels, Church of the Holy Paraskeva, Kuziy - Trybushany and back through Church of the Holy Paraskeva. It crosses from Romania into Ukraine - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. The line favours views over speed.

scenicChapters.title: Palace and Park of Versailles → Villa Savoye et loge du jardiner
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 20 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
